faqs.a:
There is hereby imposed upon each bus bench permit heretofore or hereafter issued
               to any person pursuant to section 6.17.4.A.12 of Ordinance No. 3639 a nonrefundable
               annual charge of $35.00. Any person issued a bus bench permit who fails to pay to
               the city the annual charge shall be subject to the penalties provided in
section 1-5
, and the city manager is authorized to remove forthwith the bus bench for which the
               permit was issued from the public way.
(Code 1981, § 2-196; Ord. No. 2373, § 1, 11-17-1986; Ord. No. 2420, § 1, 6-20-1988;
               Ord. No. 3751, § 1, 6-17-2002)
